bindings: Reading PHP Source Code Through A Browser

Last night Saturday 20th July 2019, as I sat through a boring day, I decided to make the night worthwhile. Feeling like a super hero all of a sudden I decided to do the almost impossible, hence our title “reading PHP source code through a browser.”

I came across an end point which had a file upload functionality.
I then decided to fill the forms and upload an image to understand how this server worked. After a 200 status, I decide to see if the site had a restriction on the type of files the server was accepting. I uploaded a php file and surprisingly i got this:
I later realized uploading the malicious PHP file unto the server didn’t look realistic. Why?

All uploads were images, and it was weird to have an upload which had no image to show.
Right clicking on the file and “opening image in new tab” didn’t show any image. That would look suspicious if the admin should see something like this on his server
